'''Jortan''' was the [[Katarn Commandos]]' medical specialist under the leadership of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]]. He carried a specialized [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="HESB" />

During the Commandos' [[mission to Hettsk]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Jortan examined the two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic pilot/Legends|pilots]] that they rescued from [[Thrawn's confederation|Imperial]] captivity, informing Page that they would require a full medical lab, but that their condition would be stable enough until they could reach a Republic [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="HESB" />
